title: Settings — Reading
description: Standalone Reading-settings panel: front-page display, posts-per-page, and feed options over the REST settings surface.

documentation.purpose: DataForm over the REST-exposed slice of WordPress's Reading Settings: `show_on_front` (latest posts vs static page), conditional `page_on_front` / `page_for_posts` selects, `posts_per_page`, `posts_per_rss`, and `rss_use_excerpt`. Reads + writes through `core-data` `useEntityRecord('root','site')` via the shared `EntityDataForm`. Composable host (`core:settings`) mounts this for the `reading` panel; workspaces mount it directly as a Reading screen.

reads.purpose: Populate the homepage / posts-page selects (published pages, _fields id,title).

interactions.effect: `edit({ show_on_front: 'posts'|'page' })`; toggles visibility of the page selects.
`edit({ … })` clamped to a positive integer (floor 1, default 10).
`await save()`; success snackbar / error notice via `useEntitySave`.

a11y.focus-management: Native DataForm focus order is sufficient.

constraints.note: `posts_per_page` / `posts_per_rss` clamp to a floor of 1 (default 10) — WordPress treats 0 as invalid and breaks pagination.
Search-engine visibility (`blog_public`) is not exposed by `/wp/v2/settings`. The panel renders an in-form notice pointing at the legacy `options-reading.php` screen.
